description:
Ostinato offers 60 original guitar lessons across 10 modules, with written course presentation in 14 languages. Start with instrument setup and strings, then build reading, single-note playing, chords, rhythm, harmony and fingerstyle. Two original final performances help you combine the skills. Each lesson includes explanations, a practice task, self-checks and easier options.

Additional introductory courses offer written piano, ukulele, bass and voice practice. Live note, finger technique and voice correctness feedback for those courses is unavailable.

Read original text lessons, follow practice tasks, review your own practice and continue from your local lesson record. You can browse without signing in and use an optional shared Motion account. The account uses your email address, account ID and optional display name; account deletion is available in the app. Course records stay on the device within the current guest or account scope. No lesson completion certifies mastery. Demonstration video is not included in this content preparation version.

Optional microphone practice displays approximate single-note observations on the device after your permission. It does not grade correctness or chords. Raw audio is not saved or uploaded. This course uses your own practice record; camera posture grades are not available.

The first 12 guitar lessons and the first 8 lessons of each other course are free. Later lessons need an optional auto-renewing subscription: Ostinato (this app) or Motion+ (all five Motion apps), monthly or yearly, with a 14-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Prices are shown in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your store account. A subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it in your store account settings before the renewal date. $measurementDisclosureLine: MEASURED / NOT MEASURED ikilisi (JabLab'in uclusunun DAR karsiligi — kendi olcum yuzeyimiz daha kucuk, uc katman UYDURMAK yerine iki katman DOGRU tutuldu; JabLab'in kendi 'WHAT WE DO NOT MEASURE' baslik desenine uyuldu, 'YET' EKLENMEDI — O-157'nin PROMISE_PATTERNS taramasi 'yet'i her baglamda yasakliyor). Kaynak: settings_screen.dart'in kendi kamera karti gerekcesi ('it measures one thing: how far your trunk leans') + PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy'nin guncel hesap-veri beyani + session_store.dart (D14, bugun). Elbow/shoulder/forearm icin 'watched, not scored' (JabLab'in uclu katmani) katilMADI — D6'da bu EKSIK-DOGRULANDI diye yazilmisti, O-164'te (2026-08-16) TAM DOGRULANDI: uc ruleset'in de (voice/piano/guitar) `referenceConsumption.coached_only` dizisi VE `userExplanation` alani VAR ('Experienced {calgi} teachers disagree about these, so we point them out but do not grade them') — ama `lesson_demo_screen.dart`in KENDI ekrani bunu yalanliyor: kart basligi 'Your elbow angle, WHEN THIS IS LIVE' (henuz degil) + ayri bir uyari 'Elbow tracking is not wired into this build — only trunk posture measures live today.' Yani ruleset SEVIYESINDE dirsek/omuz/onkol icin GERCEK referans-veri + esik-karari var (8/9 eklem, 3 calgida da AYNI set) ama CANLI PIPELINE (`CameraPostureAdapter`) bu eklemleri HIC OKUMUYOR — yalniz statik bir ogretmen-araligi (ArmRangeHint) gosteriliyor, canli bir SAYI degil. 'Watched, not scored' demek 'watched' kismini UYDURURDU — dogru cerceve 'reference exists, live tracking does not', ve bu JabLab'in tempo-hatasinin (olculuyor ama gosterilmiyor) TAM AYNISI olurdu. Description'da EKSIK birakilmaya DEVAM EDILDI, ama artik tahmin degil olcum: `lib/` grep + `lesson_demo_screen.dart`in kendi 'not wired' cumlesi.
$micClaimWhy: 2026-09-26: Founder approved optional on-device single-guitar-note observation. Explicit Start and OS permission are required. PCM stays in temporary RAM; no raw audio file, upload or automatic restart. iOS/Android native capture and permission declarations exist. The display is approximate note/Hz/cents; no correctness, chord, timing, dB(A) or mastery score. Existing paid-camera gates stay closed. Physical microphone acceptance remains open.

rationale: Realistic or cartoon violence: NONE — muzik pratigi, rakip/dovus mekanigi yok
Contests / competitive play against others: NONE — cok-oyunculu, siralama, sosyal ozellik yok
Medical/treatment information: NONE — CLAUDE.md kurali: tibbi dil yasak (wellness); onboarding_screen.dart kendi cumlesiyle teyit ediyor ('It does not diagnose anything')

User-generated content / sosyal paylasim: NONE — kamera goruntusu cihazdan hic cikmiyor, yukleme/paylasim ozelligi yok

$notClaimed: No independent skill/mastery outcome, physical-phone performance, clinical suitability, camera form grade or approved AI demonstration is asserted. This local content-preparation draft has not been uploaded.
$claimAuditWhy: F4/D6 taslagi (2026-08-16, O-156, orkestrator sevki: H-46 uyarinca attach/detach cagrilmadan). JabLab'in $claimAuditWhy'inin 3 dersi ONCEDEN uygulandi (kopyalanmadan ONCE): (1) 'saklanmiyor' KOK-DUZEYINDE kontrol edildi (session_store.dart D14, bugun) — description hem 'video hicbir zaman saklanmaz' hem 'ozet saklanir' ikisini de adiyla soyluyor, JabLab'in ucuncu-yuzey hatasina (description'in kendi ayri kopyasi kontrolsuz kalmasi) dusulmedi cunku BURADA description ILK YAZILDI, sonradan DUZELTILMEDI. (2) 'olculuyor ama gosterilmiyor' sinifi: ses metrikleri config'te TASINIYOR ama description'a HIC girmedi (yukarida $micClaimWhy) — JabLab'in tempo-hatasinin ayni sinifini ONCEDEN onledi. (3) 'MEASURED AND GRADED' asiri-iddiasi: description 'graded'/'scored' kelimesini HIC kullanmiyor, yalniz 'measures'/'reports' — ruleset'in coached_only katmani (voice/piano/guitar'in ucunde de AYNI 8 kol-eklemi) O-164'te TAM dogrulandi VE canli pipeline'in bu eklemleri hic okumadigi ortaya cikti (bkz $measurementDisclosureLine, lesson_demo_screen.dart'in kendi 'not wired' itirafi) — o katman description'a YINE eklenmedi, ama artik EKSIK-oldugu icin degil, YANLIS olacagi icin (JabLab'in tempo-hatasinin ayni sinifi: olculen-ama-gosterilmeyen bir seyi 'watched' demek).
